claim_legs.durability: All join producers and output bytes are tracked. audit.py --verify-saved reconstructs and compares the saved result; recover.py --verify-saved authenticates exact saved output. The explicit claim disposition owns the current source watcher.
claim_legs.falsify: Original selection/applicability falsifiers rerun; join controls reject omission, duplication, wrong outcomes, observer misclassification and root overlap. Original errno/header auditors remain RED on valid saved evidence and corrected verification is GREEN. The independent book watcher rejects changed counts and total-conserving redistribution.
claim_legs.rederive: Exact version-bound source and evidence catalog, complete prospective domain, original per-case verification and direct record counts reproduce selected coverage and outcomes from saved bytes.

commit_gate: Staged doctrines and required commit hooks must pass before this verified slice is committed.
earlier_falsifiers: Source and exact saved verdicts authenticated; selected per-row oracles rerun. Earlier main routines and their full embedded falsifier loops are not rerun.
scope: Revalidate only retained selected release-readback and syscall-report cases. Primary coverage and the strong-observer counterexample are disjoint. No fixture, old main, original producer, native process or new test root. Safe-call joins, close-error/omission composition and native lifetime remain separate.
